name: cut dry oak sapling
description: a small, cut, dry sapling with light gray, smooth bark
details: A small sapling, cut through close to the ground and lying bent across the soil, the white, five-pointed pith showing at the centre of its clean-cut stump.  Its bark is light gray and smooth.  It carries no leaves, having been dead long enough that they have browned and fallen, and they lie scattered beneath it, oblong and seven-lobed.  The dry wood is brittle and snaps easily.
